nl: Find people within two outgoing KNOWS hops of users interested in a given tag, then count their recent posts from a specified country by browser.
cypher:
MATCH (t:Tag {name: $tag})<-[:HAS_INTEREST]-(p:Person)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(q:Person)
WHERE p.creationDate > $personSince
WITH q, count(DISTINCT p) AS c WHERE c > 10
MATCH (q)<-[:HAS_CREATOR]-(po:Post)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(co:Country)
WHERE po.creationDate > $postSince AND co.name = $country
RETURN co.name AS country, q.browserUsed AS browser, count(DISTINCT po) AS postCount

nl: Find countries of sufficiently long messages in forums moderated by recently created people who studied at more than the threshold number of universities.
cypher:
MATCH (u:University)<-[:STUDY_AT]-(p:Person)
WHERE p.creationDate > $personDate
WITH p, count(u) AS c WHERE c > 2
MATCH (p)<-[:HAS_MODERATOR]-(f:Forum)-[:CONTAINER_OF]->(m:Message)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(co:Country)
WHERE f.title <> $excludedForumTitle AND m.length > $minLength
RETURN co.name AS countryName, count(DISTINCT f) AS forumCount
ORDER BY forumCount DESC
LIMIT 20

nl: Find browsers used by well-connected people who are within two KNOWS hops of people interested in a given tag class, then count their recent posts with a given tag.
cypher:
MATCH (tc:TagClass {name: $tagClassName})<-[:HAS_TYPE]-(t:Tag)<-[:HAS_INTEREST]-(p:Person)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(f:Person)
WHERE p.creationDate > $personSince
WITH f, count(DISTINCT t) AS c WHERE c > 5
MATCH (f)<-[:HAS_CREATOR]-(po:Post)-[:HAS_TAG]->(pt:Tag)
WHERE po.creationDate > $postSince AND pt.name = $postTagName
RETURN f.browserUsed AS browser, count(DISTINCT po) AS postCount
ORDER BY postCount DESC
LIMIT 20

nl: Rank countries containing people who are within two KNOWS hops of moderators of tagged forums, after retaining people connected to many such forums.
cypher:
MATCH (tc:TagClass {name: $tagClassName})<-[:HAS_TYPE]-(t:Tag)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(fo:Forum)-[:HAS_MODERATOR]->(p:Person)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(f:Person)
WHERE fo.creationDate < $forumBefore AND p.browserUsed = $moderatorBrowser
WITH f, count(DISTINCT fo) AS c WHERE c > 10
MATCH (f)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(city:City)-[:IS_PART_OF]->(country:Country)
WHERE f.creationDate > $personSince AND city.name <> $excludedCityName
RETURN country.name AS country, count(DISTINCT f) AS personCount
ORDER BY personCount DESC
LIMIT 20

nl: Find older registered people who studied at more than a threshold number of universities, then count long posts in forums where they are members.
cypher:
MATCH (u:University)<-[:STUDY_AT]-(p:Person)
WHERE p.creationDate < $personDate
WITH p, count(u) AS c WHERE c > 5
MATCH (p)<-[:HAS_MEMBER]-(fo:Forum)-[:CONTAINER_OF]->(po:Post)
WHERE fo.creationDate > $forumDate AND po.length > $length
RETURN fo.title, count(DISTINCT po) AS postCount

nl: Find employees with many company affiliations after a creation-date cutoff, then list forums they moderate and posts from those forums located in selected countries.
cypher:
MATCH (company:Company)<-[:WORK_AT]-(employee:Person)
WHERE employee.creationDate > $personDate
WITH employee, count(company) AS c WHERE c > 2
MATCH (employee)<-[:HAS_MODERATOR]-(forum:Forum)-[:CONTAINER_OF]->(post:Post)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(country:Country)
WHERE forum.title = $forumTitle AND post.length > $postLength
RETURN employee.firstName, employee.lastName, forum.title, post.content, post.length, country.name

nl: Select forums with many long posts located in a country, then summarize the network reach of their recent members by reachable friends' IP addresses.
cypher:
MATCH (co:Country)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(po:Post)<-[:CONTAINER_OF]-(fo:Forum)
WHERE co.name = $countryName AND po.length > $postLength
WITH fo, count(po) AS c WHERE c > 10
MATCH (fo)-[:HAS_MEMBER]->(p:Person)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(f:Person)
WHERE p.creationDate > $memberDate AND f.gender = $gender
RETURN f.locationIP AS locationIP, count(DISTINCT p) AS memberCount

nl: Find tags used by many recent comments in a country, then count interested people whose one- or two-hop acquaintances match a browser filter by tag and friend gender.
cypher:
MATCH (co:Country)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(cm:Comment)-[:HAS_TAG]->(t:Tag)
WHERE co.name = $countryName AND cm.creationDate > $commentDate
WITH t, count(cm) AS c WHERE c > 3
MATCH (t)<-[:HAS_INTEREST]-(p:Person)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(f:Person)
WHERE p.creationDate > $personDate AND f.browserUsed = $browser
RETURN t.name AS tagName, f.gender AS friendGender, count(DISTINCT p) AS interestedPersonCount

nl: From companies located in a country, rank colleagues reached through employees, then inspect where those colleagues studied.
cypher: MATCH (co:Country {name: $countryName})<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(comp:Company)<-[:WORK_AT]-(p:Person)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(colleague:Person) WHERE comp.name = $companyName AND p.creationDate > $personDate WITH colleague, count(comp) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10 MATCH (colleague)-[:STUDY_AT]->(u:University)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(ci:City)-[:IS_PART_OF]->(uc:Country) WHERE u.name = $universityName RETURN colleague.firstName, colleague.lastName, u.name, ci.name, uc.name

nl: Select tags whose tagged forums have the earliest creation dates after a cutoff, then count forums for those tags by moderator browser and gender.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tag)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(f:Forum) WHERE f.creationDate > $forumDate WITH t, min(f.creationDate) AS earliestForumDate ORDER BY earliestForumDate ASC LIMIT 1000 MATCH (t)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(f2:Forum)-[:HAS_MODERATOR]->(mod:Person) WHERE mod.creationDate > $moderatorDate RETURN mod.browserUsed AS browserUsed, mod.gender AS gender, count(DISTINCT f2) AS forumCount

nl: Rank interest tags by the youngest birthdays among recently created interested people, then count their outgoing acquaintances by the interested person's and friend's genders.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tag)<-[:HAS_INTEREST]-(p:Person) WHERE p.creationDate > $personCreationDate WITH t, max(p.birthday) AS youngestBirthday ORDER BY youngestBirthday DESC LIMIT 100 MATCH (t)<-[:HAS_INTEREST]-(p2:Person)-[:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) WHERE friend.browserUsed = $browser RETURN p2.gender AS personGender, friend.gender AS friendGender, count(DISTINCT friend) AS friendCount

nl: Find places containing a named university and enough recently created residents, then rank browsers used on long posts located there.
cypher:
MATCH (u:University)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(pl:Place)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(p:Person)
WHERE u.name = $universityName AND p.creationDate > $personSince
WITH pl, count(p) AS c WHERE c > 20
MATCH (pl)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(m:Post)
WHERE m.length > $minLength
RETURN m.browserUsed AS browser, count(m) AS postCount
ORDER BY postCount DESC
LIMIT 20

nl: Find the most locally joined forums in a city among recently created members, then summarize recent posts in those forums by browser.
cypher: MATCH (ci:City {name: $cityName})<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(p:Person)<-[:HAS_MEMBER]-(fo:Forum) WHERE p.creationDate > $memberSince WITH fo, count(p) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10 MATCH (fo)-[:CONTAINER_OF]->(po:Post) WHERE po.creationDate > $postSince RETURN po.browserUsed AS browser, count(po) AS postCount ORDER BY postCount DESC LIMIT 20

nl: Identify top interest tags among recently created people outside an excluded city, then count long messages using those tags by browser.
cypher: MATCH (ci:City)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(p:Person)-[:HAS_INTEREST]->(t:Tag) WHERE ci.name <> $excludedCity AND p.creationDate > $personSince WITH t, count(p) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10 MATCH (t)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(m:Message) WHERE m.length > $messageLength RETURN m.browserUsed AS browser, count(m) AS messageCount ORDER BY messageCount DESC LIMIT 20

nl: Find companies with the most recently joined employees interested in a tag, then rank author genders for recent posts located in the same countries as those companies.
cypher:
MATCH (t:Tag {name: $tagName})<-[:HAS_INTEREST]-(p:Person)-[:WORK_AT]->(co:Company)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(homeCountry:Country)
WHERE p.creationDate > $personDate
WITH co, count(p) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 100
MATCH (co)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(country:Country)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(po:Post)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(author:Person)
WHERE po.creationDate > $postDate
RETURN author.gender AS gender, count(DISTINCT co) AS companyCount
ORDER BY companyCount DESC LIMIT 20

nl: Rank employees hired at named companies by earliest profile creation date, then count the browsers used on posts they liked above a length threshold.
cypher:
MATCH (c:Company)<-[:WORK_AT]-(p:Person)
WHERE c.name = $companyName
WITH p, min(p.creationDate) AS creationRank
ORDER BY creationRank ASC
LIMIT 10
MATCH (p)-[:LIKES]->(po:Post)
WHERE po.length > $minPostLength
RETURN po.browserUsed AS browser, count(po) AS likedPostCount
ORDER BY likedPostCount DESC
LIMIT 20

nl: Rank recently created employees of non-excluded companies, then count their interests in tags other than the excluded tag.
cypher:
MATCH (c:Company)<-[:WORK_AT]-(p:Person)
WHERE c.name <> $excludedCompany
WITH p, max(p.creationDate) AS creationRank
ORDER BY creationRank DESC
LIMIT 100
MATCH (p)-[:HAS_INTEREST]->(t:Tag)
WHERE t.name <> $excludedTag
RETURN t.name AS tag, count(DISTINCT p) AS interestedEmployeeCount
ORDER BY interestedEmployeeCount DESC
LIMIT 20

nl: Rank countries by the number of non-excluded companies located there, then traverse into their cities, universities, and recently created students.
cypher:
MATCH (co:Company)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(cn:Country)
WHERE co.name <> $excludedCompanyName
WITH cn, count(co) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 22
MATCH (cn)<-[:IS_PART_OF]-(ci:City)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(u:University)<-[:STUDY_AT]-(p:Person)
WHERE ci.name <> $excludedCityName AND p.creationDate > $personCreatedAfter
RETURN cn.name AS countryName, ci.name AS cityName, u.name AS universityName, p.firstName AS studentFirstName, p.lastName AS studentLastName

nl: Rank universities by the latest birthday among qualifying students, then find the most common browsers used by their outgoing friends.
cypher: MATCH (u:University)<-[:STUDY_AT]-(s:Person) WHERE s.birthday > $studentBirthday WITH u, max(s.birthday) AS latestStudentBirthday ORDER BY latestStudentBirthday DESC LIMIT 100 MATCH (u)<-[:STUDY_AT]-(p:Person)-[:KNOWS]->(f:Person) WHERE p.creationDate > $activeSince AND f.gender = $friendGender RETURN u.name AS universityName, f.browserUsed AS friendBrowser, count(DISTINCT f) AS friendCount ORDER BY friendCount DESC LIMIT 20

nl: Rank universities by the most recent creation date of their qualifying students, then count recent liked posts by browser used to create those posts.
cypher: MATCH (u:University)<-[:STUDY_AT]-(s:Person) WHERE s.creationDate > $studentCreationDate WITH u, max(s.creationDate) AS latestStudentCreationDate ORDER BY latestStudentCreationDate DESC LIMIT 10 MATCH (u)<-[:STUDY_AT]-(p:Person)-[:LIKES]->(po:Post) WHERE p.gender = $studentGender AND po.creationDate > $postDate RETURN u.name AS universityName, po.browserUsed AS postBrowser, count(DISTINCT po) AS likedPostCount ORDER BY likedPostCount DESC LIMIT 20

nl: Rank universities by the earliest creation date among their qualifying students, then find the most frequent interest tags among younger students.
cypher: MATCH (u:University)<-[:STUDY_AT]-(s:Person) WHERE s.creationDate < $beforeStudentCreationDate WITH u, min(s.creationDate) AS earliestStudentCreationDate ORDER BY earliestStudentCreationDate ASC LIMIT 1000 MATCH (u)<-[:STUDY_AT]-(p:Person)-[:HAS_INTEREST]->(t:Tag) WHERE p.birthday > $interestBirthday AND t.name <> $excludedTag RETURN u.name AS universityName, t.name AS interestTag, count(DISTINCT p) AS interestedStudentCount ORDER BY interestedStudentCount DESC LIMIT 20

nl: Find browsers used by people created after a given date who are located in a specified city, keeping only people that pass the city-location threshold and then checking for a specified interest tag.
cypher:
MATCH (ci:City {name: $city})<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(p:Person)
WHERE p.creationDate > $personSince
WITH p, count(ci) AS c WHERE c > 3
MATCH (p)-[:HAS_INTEREST]->(t:Tag)
WHERE t.name = $tag
RETURN p.browserUsed AS browser, count(DISTINCT p) AS personCount
ORDER BY personCount DESC
LIMIT 20

nl: Find organisations in a specified city above the location threshold, then rank browsers used by employees who joined after a given creation date.
cypher:
MATCH (ci:City {name: $city})<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(org:Organisation)
WHERE org.name <> $excludedOrganisation
WITH org, count(ci) AS c WHERE c > 5
MATCH (org)<-[:WORK_AT]-(p:Person)
WHERE p.creationDate > $employeeSince
RETURN p.browserUsed AS browser, count(DISTINCT p) AS employeeCount
ORDER BY employeeCount DESC
LIMIT 20

nl: Rank organisations in cities by employees created before a given date, then return their workers with a selected gender.
cypher:
MATCH (ci:City)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(o:Organisation)<-[:WORK_AT]-(p:Person)
WHERE p.creationDate < $personDate
WITH o, count(p) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10
MATCH (o)<-[:WORK_AT]-(worker:Person)
WHERE worker.gender = $gender
RETURN o.name, worker.firstName, worker.lastName, worker.browserUsed

nl: Identify the top companies in a country by employees created before a cutoff date, then report browser usage among their employees of a given gender.
cypher:
MATCH (co:Country)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(comp:Company)<-[:WORK_AT]-(p:Person)
WHERE co.name = $countryName AND p.creationDate < $createdBefore
WITH comp, count(p) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10
MATCH (comp)<-[:WORK_AT]-(e:Person)
WHERE e.gender = $gender
RETURN comp.name AS companyName, e.browserUsed AS browserUsed, count(e) AS employeeCount

nl: Select companies recorded in many non-excluded places, then rank moderator genders for recent forums that include employees of those companies.
cypher: MATCH (comp:Company)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(pl:Place) WHERE comp.name <> $excludedCompany WITH comp, count(pl) AS c WHERE c > 5 MATCH (comp)<-[:WORK_AT]-(p:Person)<-[:HAS_MEMBER]-(f:Forum)-[:HAS_MODERATOR]->(md:Person) WHERE f.creationDate > $forumSince AND md.creationDate < $moderatorCreatedBefore RETURN md.gender AS moderatorGender, count(DISTINCT f) AS forumCount ORDER BY forumCount DESC LIMIT 20

nl: Find the browser usage of recent authors in a given city for posts that have more than a threshold number of non-excluded tags.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tag)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(p:Post) WHERE t.name <> $excludedTagName WITH p, count(t) AS c WHERE c > 10 MATCH (p)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(author:Person)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(city:City) WHERE author.creationDate > $personCreatedAfter AND city.name = $cityName RETURN author.browserUsed AS browserUsed, count(DISTINCT p) AS postCount ORDER BY postCount DESC LIMIT 20

nl: Find forum members associated with more than a threshold number of qualifying posts in titled forums, then return properties of their recently created KNOWS-neighborhood contacts.
cypher:
MATCH (po:Post)<-[:CONTAINER_OF]-(fo:Forum)-[:HAS_MEMBER]->(p:Person)
WHERE fo.title = $forumTitle AND po.creationDate > $postDate
WITH p, count(po) AS c WHERE c > 10
MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(f:Person)
WHERE f.creationDate > $personCreationDate
RETURN p.firstName AS personFirstName, p.lastName AS personLastName, f.firstName AS friendFirstName, f.lastName AS friendLastName, f.creationDate AS friendCreationDate

nl: Rank people interested in tags of a given tag class by their latest birthday value, then count the messages they liked by message location.
cypher:
MATCH (tc:TagClass)<-[:HAS_TYPE]-(t:Tag)<-[:HAS_INTEREST]-(p:Person)
WHERE tc.name = $tagClassName AND p.creationDate > $personSince
WITH p, max(p.birthday) AS latestBirthday
ORDER BY latestBirthday DESC
LIMIT 10000
MATCH (p)-[:LIKES]->(m:Message)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(pl:Place)
WHERE m.length > $minLikedMessageLength AND pl.name <> $excludedPlace
RETURN pl.name AS placeName, p.browserUsed AS browserUsed, count(DISTINCT m) AS likedMessageCount

nl: Find companies employing forum members created before a given date that appear across more than $n forums, then list those companies in a target country.
cypher: MATCH (fo:Forum)-[:HAS_MEMBER]->(p:Person)-[:WORK_AT]->(co:Company) WHERE p.creationDate < $personDate WITH co, count(fo) AS c WHERE c > 2 MATCH (co)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(country:Country) WHERE country.name = $countryName RETURN co.name AS companyName, country.name AS countryName

nl: Rank university alumni born after a given date by account creation time, then count messages located in the same countries as their employers by country and browser.
cypher: MATCH (u:University)<-[:STUDY_AT]-(p:Person) WHERE p.birthday > $minBirthday WITH p, min(p.creationDate) AS firstSeen ORDER BY firstSeen ASC LIMIT 1000 MATCH (p)-[:WORK_AT]->(co:Company)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(country:Country)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(msg:Message) WHERE co.name <> $companyName AND msg.creationDate > $messageDate RETURN country.name AS countryName, msg.browserUsed AS browserUsed, count(DISTINCT msg) AS messageCount

nl: Find universities with recently created students ranked by oldest student birthday, then count comments created by their students’ friends grouped by friend attributes.
cypher: MATCH (u:University)<-[:STUDY_AT]-(p:Person) WHERE p.creationDate > $personCreatedAfter WITH u, min(p.birthday) AS oldestStudentBirthday ORDER BY oldestStudentBirthday ASC LIMIT 1000 MATCH (u)<-[:STUDY_AT]-(p:Person)-[:KNOWS]->(f:Person)<-[:HAS_CREATOR]-(cm:Comment) WHERE f.gender = $friendGender AND cm.length > $commentLength RETURN f.browserUsed AS friendBrowser, f.gender AS friendGender, count(DISTINCT cm) AS commentCount

nl: Select university alumni outside a named university ranked by profile creation time, then count their forum memberships by forum title and tag class.
cypher: MATCH (u:University)<-[:STUDY_AT]-(p:Person) WHERE u.name <> $excludedUniversityName WITH p, max(p.creationDate) AS latestProfileCreation ORDER BY latestProfileCreation DESC LIMIT 100 MATCH (p)<-[:HAS_MEMBER]-(fo:Forum)-[:HAS_TAG]->(t:Tag)-[:HAS_TYPE]->(tc:TagClass) WHERE fo.creationDate < $forumBeforeDate AND tc.name <> $tagClassName RETURN tc.name AS tagClassName, fo.title AS forumTitle, count(DISTINCT fo) AS forumCount

nl: Rank forums containing long posts moderated by graduates of a chosen university, then find the most common tags liked by their recent members.
cypher: MATCH (po:Post)<-[:CONTAINER_OF]-(fo:Forum)-[:HAS_MODERATOR]->(mod:Person)-[:STUDY_AT]->(univ:University) WHERE po.length > $minPostLength AND univ.name = $universityName WITH fo, count(DISTINCT po) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 1000 MATCH (fo)-[:HAS_MEMBER]->(member:Person)-[:LIKES]->(msg:Message)-[:HAS_TAG]->(tag:Tag) WHERE member.creationDate > $memberSince AND tag.name <> $excludedTag RETURN tag.name AS tagName, count(DISTINCT member) AS memberCount ORDER BY memberCount DESC LIMIT 20
